name: Comte de Saint-Germain
original_name: サン・ジェルマン伯爵
source:
A greater (pure-blood) vampire shrouded in mystery. He is responsible for offering the inhabitants of the mansion a "taste of eternity" and granting them their second lives as vampires. 
Saint-German has graceful poise and a elegant smile, but there's the faintest hint of sadness somewhere in his eyes. 

"Let us toast to tonight's most glorious and miraculous encounter. Santré."
